name: value-utilities/transition-arbitrary
description: Arbitrary forms of the transition family: `duration-[450ms]`, `delay-[100ms]`, `ease-[cubic-bezier(...)]` (commas-in-arbitrary triggers the `\2c` selector escape path), `transition-[width,height]` and `transition-[all_300ms_ease-in-out]` (the underscore-to-space normalization mid-arbitrary). When `transition-property` is set, the `transitionProperty` plugin appends default `transition-timing-function` and `transition-duration` per upstream.
